summary: KB Financial Group filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026, reporting a board resolution to enter into a trust agreement with Samsung Securities to acquire up to KRW 700 billion (~$525M) of its own common shares by December 16, 2026. The expected acquisition price is KRW 175,100 per share, based on the July 22 closing price. Acquired treasury shares will be cancelled within one year after the contract period, boosting shareholder returns. The company currently holds 3,581,623 treasury shares (1.0%). The program is funded from distributable profits; remaining capacity is KRW 1.14 trillion. This open-market buyback, combined with planned cancellation, signals strong capital return commitment. Watch actual execution pace and any dividend policy updates.
